interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signal heads at the signalized intersection ahead.

interventions.title: Sidewalk or Multi-use Path Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved walkway separated from the roadway to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk to meet accessibility standards and relocate utility poles to provide a clear path of travel.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to provide a 3-7 second head start for pedestrians before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Path Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting along the trail to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Wayfinding Signage
interventions.description: Install clear directional and safety signage at the trail entrance.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and curb ramps at regular intervals to provide safe crossing points for residents.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
